name: kiwishare-monorepo
description: Monorepo for KiwiShare - Mobile App (Flutter) and Backend Server (Koa + TypeScript + MongoDB)

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm install --no-frozen-lockfile && cd mobile && flutter pub get
scripts.mobile:format: cd mobile && dart format --set-exit-if-changed lib/ test/
scripts.mobile:build:ios: export LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 && cd mobile && flutter config --no-enable-swift-package-manager && flutter build ios --release --no-codesign
scripts.dev: concurrently -i --default-input-target 1 --kill-others-on-fail -n server,mobile "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm mobile chrome local"
scripts.dev:android: concurrently -i --default-input-target 1 --kill-others-on-fail -n server,android "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm mobile android local"
scripts.dev:ios: concurrently -i --default-input-target 1 --kill-others-on-fail -n server,ios "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm mobile ios-device local"
scripts.dev:ios:sim: concurrently -i --default-input-target 1 --kill-others-on-fail -n server,ios-sim "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm mobile ios-sim local"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently -i --kill-others-on-fail -n server,web,mobile "pnpm server:dev" "pnpm web:dev" "pnpm mobile chrome local"
scripts.build:all: pnpm server:build && pnpm web:build && pnpm mobile:build:all
scripts.lint:all: pnpm mobile:analyze && pnpm server:lint && pnpm web:lint
